visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a night view of a snow-covered ski resort. Several ski lifts with orange lights move slowly against a dark sky. The ground is white with footprints and ski tracks. Heavy snowflakes fall across the frame, illuminated by the resort's artificial lighting. (2) A male character appears in a close-up, wearing a dark helmet, reflective goggles, and a black face mask. Snow accumulates on his gear as he looks towards the camera. The background shows blurred resort lights and the night sky filled with falling snow. (3) The scene shifts to show a ski lift carrying people up the mountain at night. The lift is brightly lit by a large floodlight, creating high contrast. Thick snow continues to fall, creating a dense atmospheric effect over the ski tracks below. (4) Daylight scene. A male snowboarder wearing a brownish jacket and black pants glides down a wide, snowy slope. He carves turns, leaving 'pencil lines' in the snow. Other skiers are visible in the distance against a background of snow-laden pine trees under a gray, overcast sky.
